confidence_notes: Numbeo's 7 June 2026 Da Nang snapshot provides city-specific meal, cappuccino and draft-beer averages. Cocktail is less certain; Expatistan shows an 80,150 VND downtown-club entry. Wine uses a 2026 local guide's 90,000–180,000 VND range, checked against the local beer price. Lodging estimates combine broad annual guides and aggregates; tax and fee inclusion is not consistently stated, and the private-hostel average also includes guesthouses.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; estimates are based on Da Nang prices.
